start: Sign-up form filled in; the owner presses 'Create my gym' and the gym is made online

steps.action: Wait for the panel to open
user_sees: A sheet titled 'Your gym is ready'
'Members type this code in the MettleUp app to join your gym.'
'Gym code' with the code in big letters
A QR code and 'Members can also scan this QR with their phone camera. The link opens the MettleUp app on your gym.'
must_not: No card, so the owner does not know the code
A code in lower case or with spaces
'Code copied.' when the browser blocked copying (it must say 'This browser blocked copying. Select the text and copy it.')

user_sees: The phone's share sheet with the invite message; on a browser without one, WhatsApp opens in a new tab with the message ready
must_not: A message sent to anyone by itself
WhatsApp opening after the owner cancelled the share sheet

user_sees: The sheet closes; Today is behind it
must_not: The card coming back on the next page or after a refresh

start: The 'Your gym is ready' sheet is open

must_not: The code copied instead of the link

user_sees: The sheet closes and the invite page of Settings opens (address /settings/invite) with the same code and link
must_not: A different code on the poster page than on the card
The sheet still open on top of the poster page

start: An owner signs in to a gym that already exists (does not press 'Create my gym')

user_sees: Today, with no 'Your gym is ready' sheet
must_not: The card shown at an ordinary sign-in
The card of a gym created earlier in this tab by someone else

user_sees: The gym code and join link are there
must_not: No way to find the code without the card

start: The 'Your gym is ready' sheet was shown once

user_sees: Today, no sheet: it is shown once only
must_not: The sheet again on every refresh

steps.action: Create the gym again in a fresh tab but close the tab before the panel draws, then open the panel
user_sees: No sheet (the note lived in the closed tab); the code is in Settings, Invite members
must_not: A sign-in error because the note is missing

start: A gym was just created in this browser tab

steps.action: See the card, tap 'Done', then sign out
must_not: The gym code left in the tab's storage after the card was shown

steps.action: A second person signs in to another gym in the same tab
must_not: The first gym's code and join link shown to the second person
